project_name: Project Maverick / Gateway Business Park data center exploration
developer: Maverick Holdings; Diversified Gas and Oil Corporation; Appalachian Industrial Development Authority
status_detail: Early-stage joint development/feasibility effort to potentially purchase about 100 acres at Gateway Business Park for a data center/high-energy user with possible on-site power generation; no tenant identified and site viability not yet proven. Letcher County later appeared in statewide moratorium tracking as having ordered a two-year halt on data centers.
notes: WYMT quotes One East Kentucky CEO Colby Kirk describing the AIDA/Diversified/Maverick Holdings agreement and emphasizing the project is very early, with hundreds of issues that could stop it. DCD summarizes the same reported agreement and notes the 100-acre plot within the 260-acre industrial park and 69kV/gas connectivity.
